This page presents the learned representations from the ALIGATEHR-Gen model and its quantitative performance against baselines. Explore the patient and ICD code embedding spaces, and compare evaluation metrics across diseases.

## Patient Embeddings — Coloured by Sex

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

patientData = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/patient_embeddings.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text, d3.autoType);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

createScatterplot = (await import("https://esm.sh/regl-scatterplot@1.9.1")).default
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

import { createEmbeddingRenderer, fitEmbeddingWidth } from "./embedding-renderer.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

reglDrilldownScatter = {
  return async function(config) {
    const data = config.data;
    const width = fitEmbeddingWidth(config.width || 1000);
    const height = Math.round(width * (config.heightRatio || 0.6));

    const container = document.createElement("section");
    container.className = "embedding-walkthrough patient-embedding-explorer";
    container.setAttribute("aria-label", `${config.title} interactive explorer`);

    const title = document.createElement("div");
    title.className = "embedding-heading";
    title.innerHTML = `<div><strong>${config.title}</strong><span>${config.subtitle}</span></div>`;
    container.appendChild(title);

    const plotFrame = document.createElement("div");
    plotFrame.className = "embedding-frame";
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;
    canvas.style.width = width + "px";
    canvas.style.height = height + "px";
    canvas.setAttribute("role", "img");
    canvas.setAttribute("aria-label", `${data.length.toLocaleString()} patient embeddings`);
    canvas.tabIndex = 0;
    plotFrame.appendChild(canvas);

    const tooltip = document.createElement("div");
    tooltip.className = "embedding-tooltip";
    plotFrame.appendChild(tooltip);

    const controls = document.createElement("div");
    controls.className = "embedding-controls";
    controls.setAttribute("aria-label", "Embedding walkthrough controls");
    const status = document.createElement("span");
    status.className = "embedding-status";
    status.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
    const backBtn = document.createElement("button");
    backBtn.className = "embedding-button";
    backBtn.textContent = "Back";
    const replayBtn = document.createElement("button");
    replayBtn.className = "embedding-button";
    replayBtn.textContent = "Replay";
    const resetBtn = document.createElement("button");
    resetBtn.className = "embedding-button";
    resetBtn.textContent = "Reset view";
    controls.append(status, backBtn, replayBtn, resetBtn);
    container.appendChild(controls);
    container.appendChild(plotFrame);

    const legend = document.createElement("div");
    legend.className = "embedding-legend patient-embedding-legend";
    container.appendChild(legend);

    const renderer = createEmbeddingRenderer({
      data,
      xField: config.xField,
      yField: config.yField,
      zValues: config.zValues,
      canvas,
      width,
      height,
      pointSize: config.pointSize || 3,
      opacity: config.opacity || 0.6,
      lassoOnLongPress: true,
      pointColor: config.scatterSet.pointColor,
      createScatterplot,
    });
    const scatterplot = renderer.scatterplot;
    const allIndices = renderer.allIndices;
    await renderer.drawOverview();
    await renderer.zoomToPoints(allIndices, { padding: 0.08 });

    let stack = [{ indices: allIndices, label: "Overview", grouped: false }];
    let isZooming = false;

    function current() {
      return stack[stack.length - 1];
    }

    function countLabel(indices) {
      const noun = config.countNoun || "points";
      return `${indices.length.toLocaleString()} ${noun}`;
    }

    function syncControls() {
      const labels = stack.map(d => d.label).join(" / ");
      status.textContent = `${labels} · ${countLabel(current().indices)}`;
      backBtn.disabled = stack.length <= 1;
      replayBtn.hidden = stack.length <= 1;
      resetBtn.disabled = stack.length <= 1;
    }

    async function applyCurrent() {
      const state = current();
      tooltip.classList.remove("is-visible");
      if (state.indices.length === allIndices.length) {
        await renderer.drawOverview();
        await scatterplot.zoomToPoints(allIndices, {
          padding: 0.08,
          transition: true,
          transitionDuration: 520,
        });
      } else {
        await renderer.drawHighlighted(state.indices, {
          opacity: [0.1, 0.9],
          pointSize: [2.25, 7],
        });
        const focusIndices = state.grouped ? allIndices : state.indices;
        await scatterplot.zoomToPoints(focusIndices, {
          padding: state.grouped ? 0.08 : 0.25,
          transition: true,
          transitionDuration: 620,
        });
      }
      syncControls();
    }

    async function pushState(indices, label, grouped = false) {
      const unique = Array.from(new Set(indices));
      if (!unique.length || isZooming) return;
      const previous = current().indices;
      if (unique.length === previous.length && unique.every((d, i) => d === previous[i])) return;
      isZooming = true;
      stack.push({ indices: unique, label, grouped });
      syncControls();
      await applyCurrent();
      isZooming = false;
    }

    async function drillIndex(index) {
      const state = current();
      const datum = data[index];
      if (config.groupAccessor && stack.length === 1) {
        const groupValue = config.groupAccessor(datum);
        const groupIndices = allIndices.filter(i => config.groupAccessor(data[i]) === groupValue);
        await pushState(groupIndices, config.groupLabel(groupValue), true);
        return;
      }
      await pushState([index], `Point ${stack.length}`);
    }

    scatterplot.subscribe("pointover", (idx) => {
      const d = data[idx];
      if (!d) return;
      tooltip.innerHTML = config.tooltip(d);
      tooltip.classList.add("is-visible");
    });
    scatterplot.subscribe("pointout", () => tooltip.classList.remove("is-visible"));
    scatterplot.subscribe("select", async ({ points: selected }) => {
      if (isZooming || !selected?.length) return;
      const currentSet = new Set(current().indices);
      const selectedInView = selected.filter(i => currentSet.has(i));
      if (selectedInView.length > 1) {
        await pushState(selectedInView, `Selection ${stack.length}`);
      } else if (selectedInView.length === 1) {
        await drillIndex(selectedInView[0]);
      }
    });

    canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      tooltip.style.left = (e.clientX - rect.left + 15) + "px";
      tooltip.style.top = (e.clientY - rect.top + 15) + "px";
    });

    backBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      if (stack.length <= 1 || isZooming) return;
      isZooming = true;
      stack.pop();
      syncControls();
      await applyCurrent();
      isZooming = false;
    });

    resetBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      if (isZooming) return;
      isZooming = true;
      stack = [{ indices: allIndices, label: "Overview", grouped: false }];
      syncControls();
      await applyCurrent();
      isZooming = false;
    });

    replayBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      if (stack.length <= 1 || isZooming) return;
      isZooming = true;
      status.textContent = `Replaying ${current().label} walkthrough`;
      await renderer.drawOverview();
      await scatterplot.zoomToPoints(allIndices, {
        padding: 0.08,
        transition: true,
        transitionDuration: 380,
      });
      await applyCurrent();
      isZooming = false;
    });

    if (config.renderLegend) {
      config.renderLegend(legend, {
        drillGroup: value => {
          const groupIndices = allIndices.filter(i => config.groupAccessor(data[i]) === value);
          pushState(groupIndices, config.groupLabel(value), true);
        },
      });
    }

    syncControls();
    return container;
  };
}
```


```{ojs}
//| echo: false

umapSex = {
  const femaleCount = patientData.filter(d => d.sex_male === 0).length;
  const maleCount = patientData.length - femaleCount;
  return reglDrilldownScatter({
    data: patientData,
    xField: "umap_1",
    yField: "umap_2",
    title: "Patient Embeddings — Coloured by Sex",
    subtitle: `Pre-trained EHR Encoder (UKB ${patientData.length.toLocaleString()} patients)`,
    scatterSet: { colorBy: "valueA", pointColor: ["#e07b39", "#4a90d9"] },
    zValues: patientData.map(d => d.sex_male),
    groupAccessor: d => d.sex_male,
    groupLabel: value => value === 1 ? "Male" : "Female",
    countNoun: "patients",
    tooltip: d => `<strong>ID: ${d.id}</strong><br>Age: ${d.age} · Sex: ${d.sex_male === 1 ? "Male" : "Female"}`,
    renderLegend: (legend, { drillGroup }) => {
      legend.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:20px;font-size:0.9rem;";
      const female = document.createElement("span");
      female.className = "patient-embedding-legend-action";
      female.tabIndex = 0;
      female.innerHTML = `<span style="display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#e07b39;margin-right:4px;vertical-align:middle;"></span>Female (n=${femaleCount.toLocaleString()})`;
      const male = document.createElement("span");
      male.className = "patient-embedding-legend-action";
      male.tabIndex = 0;
      male.innerHTML = `<span style="display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#4a90d9;margin-right:4px;vertical-align:middle;"></span>Male (n=${maleCount.toLocaleString()})`;
      female.addEventListener("click", () => drillGroup(0));
      male.addEventListener("click", () => drillGroup(1));
      [female, male].forEach(item => item.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
        if (event.key !== "Enter" && event.key !== " ") return;
        event.preventDefault();
        item.click();
      }));
      legend.append(female, male);
    },
  });
}
```

## Patient Embeddings — Coloured by Age

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

umapAge = {
  const ages = patientData.map(d => d.age);
  const minAge = Math.min(...ages);
  const maxAge = Math.max(...ages);
  const viridisStops = [
    "#440154","#482878","#3e4989","#31688e","#26828e",
    "#1f9e89","#35b779","#6ece58","#b5de2b","#fde725"
  ];
  return reglDrilldownScatter({
    data: patientData,
    xField: "umap_1",
    yField: "umap_2",
    title: "Patient Embeddings — Coloured by Age",
    subtitle: `Pre-trained EHR Encoder (UKB ${patientData.length.toLocaleString()} patients)`,
    scatterSet: { colorBy: "valueA", pointColor: viridisStops },
    zValues: patientData.map(d => (d.age - minAge) / (maxAge - minAge)),
    countNoun: "patients",
    tooltip: d => `<strong>ID: ${d.id}</strong><br>Age: ${d.age} · Sex: ${d.sex_male === 1 ? "Male" : "Female"}`,
    renderLegend: (legend) => {
      legend.style.cssText = "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:0.9rem;";
      const gradBar = document.createElement("div");
      gradBar.style.cssText = "width:200px;height:14px;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(to right, #440154, #482878, #3e4989, #31688e, #26828e, #1f9e89, #35b779, #6ece58, #b5de2b, #fde725);";
      legend.append(document.createTextNode(minAge + " "), gradBar, document.createTextNode(" " + maxAge));
      const ageTitle = document.createElement("span");
      ageTitle.style.cssText = "margin-left:8px;color:#6c757d;";
      ageTitle.textContent = "Age";
      legend.appendChild(ageTitle);
    },
  });
}
```

## ICD-10 Code Embedding UMAP {#icd-embedding}

Use the chatbot to request a reviewed ICD Keyword Match, or search the tracked code nodes directly below. Keyword actions are navigation-only and remain separate from Demo Profile comparison.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

import { createIcdKeywordScatter } from "./icd-keyword-scatter.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

icdData = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/icd_code_embeddings.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text, d3.autoType);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof icdSearch = Inputs.text({ label: "Search ICD code or description", placeholder: "e.g. E11, diabetes, circulatory..." })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

icdUmap = {
  const query = icdSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
  const schemeCategory20 = [
    "#1f77b4","#ff7f0e","#2ca02c","#d62728","#9467bd",
    "#8c564b","#e377c2","#7f7f7f","#bcbd22","#17becf",
    "#aec7e8","#ffbb78","#98df8a","#ff9896","#c5b0d5",
    "#c49c94","#f7b6d2","#c7c7c7","#dbdb8d","#9edae5"
  ];
  let removeRequestListener = () => {};
  let chart = null;
  invalidation.then(() => {
    removeRequestListener();
    if (chart) chart.icdKeywordWalkthrough.destroy();
  });

  let helper = window.ALIGATEHR_ICD_KEYWORD;
  for (let attempt = 0; !helper && attempt < 20; attempt += 1) {
    await new Promise(resolve => window.setTimeout(resolve, 50));
    helper = window.ALIGATEHR_ICD_KEYWORD;
  }
  if (!helper) throw new Error("The ICD visualization request helper is unavailable.");

  const consumed = helper.consumeRequest(sessionStorage);
  chart = await createIcdKeywordScatter({
    data: icdData,
    createScatterplot,
    colors: schemeCategory20,
    searchQuery: query,
    request: consumed.request,
    autoplay: consumed.should_play,
  });
  removeRequestListener = helper.connectRequestConsumer(
    window,
    sessionStorage,
    request => chart.icdKeywordWalkthrough.focus(request),
  );
  window.__ALIGATEHR_ICD_READY__ = true;
  return chart;
}
```

## Evaluation Metrics Comparison

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

evalData = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/evaluation_metrics.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text, d3.autoType);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof selectedMetric = Inputs.select(
  [...new Set(evalData.map(d => d.metric))],
  { label: "Metric", value: "AUROC" }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

evalChart = {
  const filtered = evalData.filter(d => d.metric === selectedMetric);
  const diseases = [...new Set(filtered.map(d => d.disease))];
  const models = [...new Set(filtered.map(d => d.model))];

  // Sort diseases by proposed model performance (descending)
  const proposed = filtered.filter(d => d.is_proposed);
  diseases.sort((a, b) => {
    const va = proposed.find(d => d.disease === a)?.value || 0;
    const vb = proposed.find(d => d.disease === b)?.value || 0;
    return vb - va;
  });

  const proposedModel = "ALIGATEHR-Gen";
  const grayScale = ["#888","#aaa","#666","#999","#bbb","#777","#ccc","#555","#ddd"];
  const modelColors = {};
  let gi = 0;
  for (const m of models) {
    modelColors[m] = m === proposedModel ? "#2c5aa0" : grayScale[gi++ % grayScale.length];
  }

  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: 1000,
    height: 420,
    marginLeft: 180,
    marginRight: 20,
    x: { label: selectedMetric, grid: true },
    y: { label: null, domain: diseases },
    color: { legend: true },
    marks: [
      // Error bars (if CI available)
      Plot.ruleX(filtered.filter(d => d.ci_lower != null && d.ci_upper != null), {
        x1: "ci_lower",
        x2: "ci_upper",
        y: "disease",
        stroke: d => modelColors[d.model],
        strokeWidth: 1.5,
        strokeOpacity: 0.5,
      }),
      // Dots
      Plot.dot(filtered, {
        x: "value",
        y: "disease",
        fill: d => modelColors[d.model],
        r: d => d.model === proposedModel ? 6 : 4,
        symbol: d => d.model === proposedModel ? "circle" : "diamond2",
        tip: true,
        title: d => `${d.model}\n${d.disease}\n${selectedMetric}: ${d.value.toFixed(4)}${d.ci_lower != null ? `\nCI: [${d.ci_lower.toFixed(4)}, ${d.ci_upper.toFixed(4)}]` : ""}`,
      }),
    ],
  });

  // Wrap with title
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  const titleDiv = document.createElement("div");
  titleDiv.innerHTML = `<strong style="font-size:1.1rem;color:#2c3e50;">Model Performance Comparison</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#6c757d;">${models.length} models × ${diseases.length} diseases · Metric: ${selectedMetric}</span>`;
  titleDiv.style.marginBottom = "8px";
  container.appendChild(titleDiv);
  container.appendChild(chart);

  // Custom legend
  const legendDiv = document.createElement("div");
  legendDiv.style.cssText = "margin-top:8px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;font-family:'Source Sans Pro',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;";
  for (const m of models) {
    const color = modelColors[m];
    const shape = m === proposedModel ? "●" : "◆";
    const weight = m === proposedModel ? "font-weight:600;" : "";
    legendDiv.innerHTML += `<span style="${weight}"><span style="color:${color};margin-right:3px;">${shape}</span>${m}</span>`;
  }
  container.appendChild(legendDiv);

  return container;
}
```
